text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Trainer! First place! We got 
first place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Training together from early morning, 
holding strategy meetings until late at 
night...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of those steps led to 
this path... to this victory!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was the ultimate victory!
Yeah, it was the greatest victory!
Let's rack up even more wins.

Ooh! If it has Trainer-san's stamp of 
approval, then there's no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Let's win our next race too! Aiming for 
even greater heights!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I had a feeling you'd say that, 
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let us rack up so many victories that they 
pierce through the sky!
